info.title: API.SH: Etsy
info.description: The Etsy API from API.SH: public Etsy data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Etsy's search box suggestions for typed text: each suggested query with its search link, the query Etsy would prefetch, and the link to search shop names containing the text.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/etsy-autocomplete

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Listings in an Etsy category (etsy.com/c/...), with the site's sort and filters: price range, free shipping, on sale, Star Seller and ship-to country. Returns the category name, breadcrumbs, its subcategories (pass a `path` back to drill down), `listing_ids` (every result on the page, 48 or more, in rank order) and `listings` (cards with price, discount, rating, shop, flags and image). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/etsy-category

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Category path after /c/ in an Etsy link, e.g. `home-and-living/kitchen-and-dining` or `jewelry/necklaces`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An etsy.com /c/ category link, instead of `path`.

parameters.name: ship_to
parameters.description: Two-letter country the listing ships to.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-250). Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One listing: price, availability and quantity, rating and reviews, shop, description, category path, favorites, ships-from, shipping rate, returns, variations with their options and all images. Also the item highlights (made to order, materials ...), the review summary tags, the sub-ratings (item quality, shipping, customer service, percent of buyers who recommend), review topics with their review counts, the estimated delivery window and the return policy. Also `variation_options` (each variation option with its own price and a sold-out flag), `personalization` (available, required, and each personalization field with its label, type, instructions, character limit and options), `processing_time` (when the page states it) and `shop_stats` (shop sales, shop review count, years on Etsy, Star Seller).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/etsy-listing

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The buyer reviews of one listing, 8 a page: stars, review text, date, buyer, buyer photos, the seller's reply and the reviewed item, plus the listing's review total, average rating, star distribution and the topics buyers mention. Give the listing `id` or `url`, or `q` to open the first search result for those words. Sort by relevance, newest, highest or lowest rating, or keep one star level with `rating`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/etsy-listing_reviews

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words; the reviews of the first matching listing are returned.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this many stars.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Listings for a query on etsy.com with sort, price range, free shipping, on sale, Star Seller, customizable, ship-to country and shop location filters, and a Bestseller filter. `listings` has full details for every result on the page (about 40-48) in rank order, followed by the sponsored listings Etsy shows on it (`ad: true`); `listing_ids` lists the results alone in rank order, and any of them can be passed to /etsy/v1/listing. Pass `next_page` back as `page`. Also filter by item format (digital downloads or physical items), personalizable listings and the page's attribute filters (color, material, occasion and the category's own attributes); `attribute_filters` lists the attribute groups and values the search offers, for `attributes`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/etsy-search

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

parameters.name: bestseller
parameters.description: 1 to keep only the results Etsy marks as Bestseller (`bestseller: true`) on this page. `bestseller_count` always gives how many results on the page carry the badge; `next_page` still pages the full result list.

parameters.name: item_format
parameters.description: `digital` for digital downloads only, `physical` to leave digital downloads out.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Attribute filters as `param:value` pairs, comma-separated, from `attribute_filters` of an earlier search (e.g. `attr_357:83` for material Ceramic). Several pairs must all match.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

listings.title: Solstice Mug: Handmade Pottery Mug with Sun Design, Ceramic Coffee Cup in a Variety of Colors

get.description:
A shop's profile: title, description, location, rating and review count, sales, admirers, year joined, Star Seller status, item count, announcement, and one page of its listings (about 36 per page). Pass `next_page` back as `page` for the next page; it is null on the last page. Also the shop headline, about story and its headline, the owner's name, the listing sections with their counts, and the policies (last updated date, accepted payment methods, returns text). Also `sales_text` (the sales figure as the page rounds it, e.g. 3.9M). The shop page shows only the recency-weighted average and the review count (no star distribution).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/etsy-shop

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Listings page (1 = first). Pass `next_page` back here.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Listing order: `custom` (the shop's own order, default), `newest`, `price_asc` or `price_desc`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every active listing of a shop, 36 a page: id, title, price, image and link, plus the shop's listing total. Sort by the shop's own order, newest or price, narrow to one shop section with `section_id`, or search inside the shop with `q`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/etsy-shop_listings

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Listing order (default: the shop's own order).

parameters.name: section_id
parameters.description: Only listings of this shop section (ids are in the shop route's response).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Listings Etsy recommends on a listing's page: `similar` (the "Similar items" module, about a dozen listings from other shops, some marked `ad`) and `more_from_shop` (other listings from the same shop). Each card: id, title, url, price, currency, original price and discount when on sale, rating and review count when shown, shop, shop id, Bestseller / Star Seller / free shipping flags and image. Any id can be passed to /etsy/v1/listing.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/etsy-similar

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
